description: seal-til-block v0 round derivation (SPEC §7.6). Given the quicknet genesis + period and a fixed (current_tip, unlock_block, now_ms) triple, the drand round a sealed message's reveal-secret R is timelocked to is deterministic: round = roundAt(now_ms + max(0, unlock_block - current_tip) * 600000), where roundAt(t) = floor((t - genesis*1000) / (period*1000)) + 1. The 600000ms/block leg is an APPROXIMATION; std_dev_hours = 10*sqrt(blocks_ahead)/60 quantifies its spread.
notes: roundAt is the canonical drand-client formula, reimplemented pure so round derivation needs no network and no tlock-js in the initial bundle. Cross-checked live against drand-client's roundAt (identical). The displayed unit is unlock_block (a Bitcoin block height); the key RELEASE is drand-round (wall-clock) based — this leg fails the Ed25519 test (WHY H5). std_dev grows with the horizon: ~0.4h at 6 blocks, ~2h at a day, ~11h at a month.
